## Nutrition Prior to Surgery

High-protein diet (60-80 grams protein/day)

- Protein shakes (Premier or Fairlife) with minimal sugar

Important to avoid weight loss prior to surgery

Good nutrition improves wound healing and recovery

## Exercise Prior to Surgery

Goal: 30 minutes of vigorous exercise 6 days/week

Vigorous: Working hard enough you can't talk

Types of Exercise:

- Walking: Outside, Treadmilll, or an indoor Mall
- Stationary Exercise Bike

Light weights and stretching are helpful in addition
